closed_issues.title: More systematic exploration of MaxQuant output
closed_issues.description:
There are many often partly redundant files: msms.txt, allPeptides.txt, evidence.txt
They present the data on different levels.

We want to extract all relevant information that can be matched to a peak (pair retention time, ms/z) in MS1.

Implementation would require
- Read full set of relevant files and extract information per feature (pair of scan number + file name)
- Filter for irrelevant features (e.g. too low score, bad spectrum, ..., will need to be defined)
- Assemble entries for each feature combining MS1 with MS2 + properties like charge, identification score, ..., and also quantifications. A clear definition of what is what will be needed.
- (Question) Would a database taking features on this level be efficient?
- Summary of MS run for general quality control and addition of metadata from PRIDE

closed_issues.title: Story: Improve design for current architecture
closed_issues.description:
The current architecture is based on pipeline architecture with a monolitich-ish design.

The pipeline flow needs to be preserved while adding flexibility to the ecosystem via component and layers based design.

Based on work from #2 we can abstract away some concepts and achieve the above scenario.

Some examples to start the story: 

* conceptualize the filtering (i.e. can we describe a general framework for users to add particularize ms2ai with code for their own filtering needs)

* conceptualize the data source

* conceptualize raw data formats and extraction
